scope: local public fixture; one end-to-end flow, not general benchmark superiority

design_repair.original_failure: unverified concurrency guarantee asserted as current fact
design_repair.corrections: guarantee scoped to actual contract; dependent scenarios/tests corrected; sent/inflight/lost response states separated

handoff.implementation: Codex, new session without planner conversation
handoff.plan_review: returned for extra policy -> corrected -> ok
handoff.final_independent_review: Claude; G1-G5 satisfied, actual participant message meaning and storage observer checked

limitations: global harness configuration not fully isolated
finite concurrency trials, not all possible interleavings
actual operations data and field effects unverified
checker audit revisions made independently before reading the generated implementation outcome; same final checker used for before/after
raw_artifacts_local: local run records, not included in this repository
criteria_note: 이 기록은 criteria.md·answer.txt 도입 전 기준으로 측정했다: 옛 충돌 기록 정책이 원문·환경에 없는데 판정기가 한 정책을 가정했고, 외부 검사는 12개였다(지금 13개). 지금 기준의 결과로 세지 않는다.
